title: Jets will not exercise Mazi Smith's option for 2027

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets will not exercise Mazi Smith's option for 2027
sources.description: The Jets announced on Wednesday that they have exercised their fifth-year option on edge rusher Will McDonald's contract, but they did not share their plans for defensive tackle Mazi Smith.
